commit 34d01ebe9f45172bcd16822a2124ae79a2dc22ec
Date: Thu Jul 19 18:38:03 2012 -0500

Updater: prefer the update site's current versions to locally-cached ones

A rather embarrassing bug entered the ImageJ Updater which prevents
it from updating components because local db.xml.gz's versions are
preferred over those from the update site.

diff --git a/core/updater/core/src/main/java/imagej/updater/core/XMLFileReader.java b/core/updater/core/src/main/java/imagej/updater/core/XMLFileReader.java
ind...

result.reasoning: This commit introduced the `filesFromThisSite` Set used to track which files belong to the currently-processed update site, and used it to decide whether to override existing files (shadowing logic). However, it never cleared this set at the start of processing each new update site's read() call, so state from a previous update site persisted and blocked shadowing/overriding files in later reads. The fix commit simply adds `filesFromThisSite.clear();` at the start of `read()`, directly correcting the omission introduced when this field and its usage were first added.
